# Repository map

*Generated by the repository map in A-Viable-Fork/Repo-Infrastructure's kit from the files git sees, their Role headers and `repo-map-manifest.json`. Do not edit by hand; the kit's `repomap` check fails when it is stale.*

## 1. Directories

| Directory | Holds |
|---|---|
| `.` | A typed map of mathematical transformations across eight domains, with its fill layer, audit, receipts, formal links and Lean project. |
| `.github` | GitHub configuration. |
| `.github/workflows` | Continuous integration. |
| `.infra` | Part of the vendored kit, pinned by infra.lock.json (Repo-Infrastructure). |
| `.infra/checks` | Part of the vendored kit, pinned by infra.lock.json (Repo-Infrastructure). |
| `.infra/lib` | Part of the vendored kit, pinned by infra.lock.json (Repo-Infrastructure). |
| `.infra/tools` | Part of the vendored kit, pinned by infra.lock.json (Repo-Infrastructure). |
| `audit` | The audit: the fixed random sample, its field-by-field grades, and the targeted grades. |
| `audit/blind` | The blind second reading of the Mathlib match grades: the packet, the answer key, and each reader's grades. |
| `catalogue` | The paper catalogue: every paper the map cites and how deeply it has been read. |
| `catalogue/imports` | Paper lists imported from sibling repositories, bibliographic fields and reading status only. |
| `domains` | The map, readable, one file per domain (generated by scripts/build.mjs). |
| `excerpts` | Verbatim windows that receipt claims, each with its source URL and the hash of the source as fetched. |
| `lean` | A Lean 4 project on the pinned Mathlib that states and proves claims Mathlib does not cover. |
| `lean/MathMap` | The Lean sources, one file per topic, each naming the entries it bears on. |
| `mapfill` | The fill layer the parser applies over the landed map: clone resolution, fills, additions, conditions, corrections, invariants and formal links. |
| `reports` | Generated reports on data quality, error rates, the catalogue and the formal queue. |
| `scripts` | The parser, query tool, checks, build and tool server. Node, no dependencies. |
| `source` | The map as landed, verbatim, and the report its D7 names come from. |

## 2. Code

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `.infra/checks/corrections.mjs` | corrections (FUNCTIONS.md F12). |
| `.infra/checks/dashes.mjs` | the style floor. |
| `.infra/checks/docgraph.mjs` | the document graph (FUNCTIONS.md F10). |
| `.infra/checks/freshness.mjs` | generated files stay fresh (FUNCTIONS.md F8). |
| `.infra/checks/headers.mjs` | self-description (FUNCTIONS.md F9). |
| `.infra/checks/kit.mjs` | the kit's own integrity in a consuming repository (FUNCTIONS.md F6). |
| `.infra/checks/leak.mjs` | the leak check. |
| `.infra/checks/lean-audit.mjs` | the proof-assistant audit (FUNCTIONS.md F21). |
| `.infra/checks/provenance.mjs` | keeps landed sources verbatim. |
| `.infra/checks/receipts.mjs` | receipts (FUNCTIONS.md F5). |
| `.infra/checks/repomap.mjs` | the repository map stays complete and current (FUNCTIONS.md F9). |
| `.infra/lib/anchor.mjs` | the kit pin's out-of-tree anchor (FUNCTIONS.md F19). |
| `.infra/lib/core.mjs` | shared plumbing for every kit check: the consumer's config, its file list, glob matching, hashing. |
| `.infra/lib/headers.mjs` | reads what a file says about itself. |
| `.infra/lib/lean.mjs` | shared plumbing for the proof-assistant audit (FUNCTIONS.md F21): the hash of a Lean project's sources, the status a declaration's axioms earn, and the parse of Lean's `#print axioms` output. |
| `.infra/lib/repomap.mjs` | the repository map (FUNCTIONS.md F9), generalized from A-Viable-Fork/philosophy scripts/repo-map.mjs and A-Viable-Fork/physics build/emit-repo-map.mjs. |
| `.infra/run.mjs` | the gate (FUNCTIONS.md F1). |
| `.infra/tools/corrections-report.mjs` | renders the corrections report (FUNCTIONS.md F12), in the form of A-Viable-Fork/phone's. |
| `.infra/tools/land.mjs` | lands a source verbatim: fetches it, writes it unmodified, and records it in the provenance manifest beside it. |
| `.infra/tools/leak-add.mjs` | adds a value to a repository's leak denylist without writing the value anywhere. |
| `.infra/tools/lean-audit.mjs` | writes the audit the lean-audit check verifies (FUNCTIONS.md F21): runs `#print axioms` on each declaration through the project's own toolchain and records each one's axioms and status, with the hash of the Lean sources it was taken from. |
| `.infra/tools/receipt.mjs` | lands receipts (FUNCTIONS.md F5). |
| `.infra/tools/repo-map.mjs` | writes the repository map the repomap check verifies (FUNCTIONS.md F9). |
| `audit/blind/rulings-0_1.js` | rulings on the disagreements of the second readings of packet-0_1. |
| `audit/grades-0_1.js` | the audit grades for audit/sample-0_1.json. |
| `audit/targeted-0_1.js` | targeted receipts. |
| `mapfill/additions.js` | additions. |
| `mapfill/conditions.js` | conditions and counterexamples. |
| `mapfill/corrections.js` | receipted corrections. |
| `mapfill/d7-a.js` | authored fills for the math map's D7 stubs, part A (D7-001 to D7-090): the categorical core. |
| `mapfill/d7-b.js` | authored fills for the math map's D7 stubs, part B (D7-091 to D7-174): universal algebra, rings, fields, groups and rewriting. |
| `mapfill/d7-c.js` | authored fills for the math map's D7 stubs, part C (D7-175 to D7-278): order and lattices, homological algebra, spectral sequences, derived categories. |
| `mapfill/d7-d.js` | authored fills for the math map's D7 stubs, part D (D7-279 to D7-366): topos theory, categorical logic, higher categories and operads. |
| `mapfill/d7-e.js` | authored fills for the math map's D7 stubs, part E (D7-367 to D7-416, and D7-465): optics, categorical quantum mechanics, Lie theory. |
| `mapfill/fill.js` | the fill record constructor, shared by every mapfill/ part file. |
| `mapfill/flags.js` | known-bad landed entries. |
| `mapfill/formal.js` | the formal layer's data. |
| `mapfill/homes.js` | authored fills for the map's missing homes. |
| `mapfill/index.js` | the fill layer's index. |
| `mapfill/invariants.js` | the invariant vocabulary. |
| `mapfill/lean.js` | the Lean layer's registry. |
| `scripts/audit.mjs` | the math map audit. |
| `scripts/blind.mjs` | second readings of the Mathlib match grades. |
| `scripts/build.mjs` | the build. |
| `scripts/catalogue-import.mjs` | imports the paper list of a sibling repository into catalogue/imports/NAME.json, bibliographic fields and reading status only (id, title, authors, year, status). |
| `scripts/catalogue.mjs` | the paper catalogue. |
| `scripts/check-all.mjs` | the gate. |
| `scripts/compose.mjs` | composition. |
| `scripts/evidence.mjs` | evidence per claim. |
| `scripts/excerpt.mjs` | the excerpt maker. |
| `scripts/formal.mjs` | the formal layer. |
| `scripts/lean.mjs` | the Lean layer's gate. |
| `scripts/mathmap.mjs` | the math map, made queryable. |
| `scripts/mcp.mjs` | the map as a tool server. |

| `infra.json` | Configuration of the vendored Repo-Infrastructure kit: which checks run. |
| `infra.lock.json` | Pins the vendored kit in .infra/: upstream commit and the hash of every file. |
| `lean/.gitignore` | Keeps Lake's build directory out of git. |
| `lean/AUDIT.json` | Each registered declaration's axioms, status (proved or stated) and dependencies, regenerated by scripts/lean.mjs --audit. |
| `lean/MathMap.lean` | The library root; imports every MathMap module. |
| `lean/MathMap/Cone.lean` | The cone on a space as a quotient, contractible when the space is nonempty (D4-075). |
| `lean/MathMap/HTransform.lean` | The Doob h-transform of Brownian motion with h(x) = x, giving the Bessel-3 generator (D5-037). |
| `lean/MathMap/Implementation.lean` | Nash implementation and Maskin monotonicity (D7-X05). |
| `lean/MathMap/LawvereTierney.lean` | Lawvere-Tierney topologies, read in the truth values (D7-288). |
| `lean/MathMap/LawvereTierneyInternal.lean` | Lawvere-Tierney topologies, internally (D7-288). |
| `lean/MathMap/Meta.lean` | Audit support: the #mathmap_deps command that lists the MathMap definitions a statement depends on. |
| `lean/MathMap/OpenGames.lean` | Open games and their monoidal product (D7-X04). |
| `lean/MathMap/Order.lean` | Antitone Galois connections (D1-099). |
| `lean/MathMap/StoneCech.lean` | Stone-Cech compactification and separability (D2-168). |
| `lean/MathMap/SubtoposColimits.lean` | The inclusion of a subtopos need not preserve colimits (D7-X02). |
| `lean/MathMap/Topos.lean` | Subtoposes, essential geometric morphisms and levels. |
| `lean/WISHLIST.md` | What the map's claims need from Mathlib and do not find there, ordered by the links each would unlock. |
| `lean/lake-manifest.json` | Lake's pinned dependencies (Mathlib at the map's pinned commit). |
| `lean/lakefile.toml` | The Lake project definition. |
| `lean/lean-toolchain` | The pinned Lean toolchain. |
| `map.json` | Every entry, machine-readable (generated by scripts/build.mjs). |
| `mapfill/README.md` | What the fill layer is, what it corrects in the landed map, and how fills are graded. |
| `repo-map-manifest.json` | Descriptions the repository map reads. |
| `reports/AUDIT.md` | Audit error rates by stratum and field, with every grade's receipt (generated by scripts/audit.mjs). |
| `reports/CATALOGUE.md` | The paper checklist (generated by scripts/catalogue.mjs). |
| `reports/FORMAL-QUEUE.md` | Unreviewed name matches against Mathlib, still to be read (generated by scripts/formal.mjs). |
| `reports/MATHMAP.md` | Data quality of the parsed and filled map (generated by scripts/mathmap.mjs). |
| `reports/SECOND-READING.md` | The blind second reading compared with the map's grades (generated by scripts/blind.mjs). |
| `source/Category_Theory_Transformation_Enumeration.pdf` | The D7 mapper report the D7 names come from. |
| `source/math_map.md` | The map as landed, verbatim; never edited. |
